samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Converts 4-bit parallel data to a serial output.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal, active low.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal indicating availability of serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output representing the converted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DATA_WIDTH">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <reg id="cnt" type="sequential_logic" width="2">Counter to track the bit position.</reg>
        <reg id="data" type="sequential_logic" width="4">Register to hold the parallel data.</reg>
        <wire id="valid" type="combinational_logic">Internal valid signal.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 2'b00;
                data <= 4'b0000;
                valid_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt == 2'b11) begin
                    data <= d;
                    cnt <= 2'b00;
                    valid_out <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    valid_out <= 1'b0;
                    data <= {data[2:0], d[cnt]};
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
